northStar: Replace the current quest-reaction cluster with one deep, event-driven module built from current main without preserving V1 save state.

module.name: PDV_QuestReactionRuntime
callerResponsibilities: PlayerEvents adapts engine events and supplies logical act identity.
Optional adapters submit semantic event IDs and never submit deity outcomes.
Callers do not load catalogs, inspect queue state, schedule work, or finalize presentation.

authoring.checkMode: regenerate in memory and normalized-text compare every generated JSON/XML file
authoring.writeMode: write deterministic LF text and exact-byte receipts
